getMTQPriceWithGuard().details: §3.5 Price-safety guard. Reverts if price is outside the 0.50–2.00 band.

genesisMint(uint256).notice: Genesis event (§13.1): mint `amount` MTQ to the Genesis Reserve         (locked — excluded from circulating supply).

mint(uint256).notice: Deposits `usdcAmount` USDC (6 decimals) and mints MTQΣ (18 dec)         = usdcNet / P_MTQ. Fee 0.10%. Throttled by status.         USDC is 6 decimals; we scale to 18 before dividing by price (1e18).

redeem(uint256).notice: Burns `mtqAmount` MTQΣ (18 dec) and returns USDC (6 dec)         = mtqAmount × P_MTQ × (1 − fee), scaled from 18→6 decimals.         Fee by status: NORMAL/CAUTION 0.15%, DEFENSIVE 0.5%, EMERGENCY 2%.
